Close a small feature to recover claimant or extend for more points; merge competing claims for shared/majority score, deny completion by geometry, preserve claimant supply.

How to play
Twenty-four square tiles have roads, city sides and fields; drawn tile rotates and must match every adjacent edge. Completed road closed at junction/end both ends; city closed on every exposed city edge. Majority claimants score feature, ties all score; claimants return. End incomplete features score half rounded down.
Higher feature score after tile stock ends wins, equal draw; house victory natural loss.
